The case: Zhao 3, acting as village representative, took deposits from villagers, stored in bank, got real deposit certificates, forged fake certificates, gave to villagers, then used real certificates to withdraw money for personal use, etc. The prosecution says it's fraud (诈骗罪) with especially large amount. The defense argued misappropriation (挪用资金罪) but not applicable. So correct answer: 诈骗. Possibly also "非法集资"? But the description is fraud. In examples they output "信用卡诈骗". For generic they output "诈骗". So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关证件"? No. It's forging deposit certificates, but that's part of fraud. The crime is fraud. So single.
